This notebook relies heavily on: 

1. [Analyzing RNA-seq data with DESeq2](https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/vignettes/DESeq2/inst/doc/DESeq2.html)

2. [RNA-Seq workflow: gene-level exploratory analysis and differential expression](https://f1000research.com/articles/4-1070/v2)

3. [Beginner’s guide to using the DESeq2 package](https://bioc.ism.ac.jp/packages/2.14/bioc/vignettes/DESeq2/inst/doc/beginner.pdf)

4. [Count Regression](https://stats4nr.com/count-regression)

5. [Exploring DESeq2 results: Wald test](https://hbctraining.github.io/DGE_workshop_salmon_online/lessons/05b_wald_test_results.html)



## Strategy

1. Load Master Data set

2. Load Individual Sample Data Sets

3. For each VHH in the sample sets
  * Locate in master set, and assign clone id

4. Proceed with DESeq2


Global_Clone_Experiment_9_S18_demand_two_min_threshold_clone-pass.csv

  print(nm)

  clone_count <- length(unique(files[[nm]]$clone_id))
  print(clone_count)
  print(sum(files[[nm]]$duplicate_count))
  
  if (nm != "master"){
    files[[nm]]$junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(files[[nm]]$junction_aa)
    files[[nm]]$VHH <- fixed_translate_DNA(files[[nm]]$sequence_alignment)
    # Note: Substring 12? What's up here? # 17? 11?
    files[[nm]]$VHH <- substr(files[[nm]]$VHH, 11, nchar(files[[nm]]$VHH))
    files[[nm]] <- unproductive(files[[nm]])
  }
  
  print("After-Cleaning:")
  print(length(unique(files[[nm]]$clone_id)))
  print(sum(files[[nm]]$duplicate_count))
  cat('\n')
  
  if (max_clone_count < clone_count){
    max_clone_count <- clone_count
    max_id <- nm
  }
}

## First Step: Assign Identical Clonal Families across Experiments

We'll do this with `junction_aa` for now, then we will use `VHH` later?

```{r}
res <- data.frame()

for (f in names(files)[names(files) != "master"]){
  # Subset data frame
  tmp <- files[[f]]
  print(f)
  #print(table(tmp$clone_id))
  # Iterate over each VHH
  count <- 0
  max_count <- length(unique(tmp$junction_aa))
  for (CDR3 in unique(tmp$junction_aa)){
    count <- count + 1
    if (round(count/max_count*100, 2) %% 5 == 0) cat("Progress:", round(count/max_count*100, 2), '\n')
    tmp_frame <- tmp[tmp$junction_aa == CDR3,]
    tmp_frame$clone_id <- rep(master[which(master$junction_aa == CDR3),]$clone_id[1], nrow(tmp_frame))
    tmp_frame$f <- rep(f, nrow(tmp_frame))
    # Rbind those
    res <- rbind(res, tmp_frame)
  }
}
```


### Save files for making Logoplots, etc.

## Modeling

```{r}
# Set reference to source
sample_info$condition <- relevel(sample_info$condition, ref = "Source")

# Create DESeqDataSet object
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = count_data, 
                              colData = sample_info, 
                              design = ~ condition)

# Perform differential expression analysis
dds <- DESeq(dds)
```

```{r}
# Get differential expression results
res <- results(dds)

# Show the top differentially expressed reads
top_genes <- res[order(res$padj, decreasing = F), ]

# Ignore those that are downregulated-- they are not important
top_genes <- na.omit(top_genes[top_genes$log2FoldChange > 0,])
```

## Visualization

```{r}
# Install and load necessary packages if not already installed
library(gplots)

# Extract normalized counts from DESeqDataSet object
normalized_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)

# Subset normalized counts to include only the top differentially expressed genes
top_genes_ids <- rownames(top_genes)
normalized_counts_top <- normalized_counts[top_genes_ids, ]

# Create a heatmap
heatmap.2(as.matrix(normalized_counts_top), 
          scale = "row",  # Scale rows to z-scores
          trace = "none", # Remove grid lines
          margins = c(10, 15), # Increase margins for row and column dendrogram
          main = "Heatmap of Top Differentially Expressed Antibodies",
          Colv = FALSE,# TRUE, # Do not cluster columns
          dendrogram = "none",#"row", # Add row dendrogram
          key = TRUE, keysize = 0.85, key.title = "Z-score",
          density.info = "none", # Do not show density plot
          cexRow = 0.8, cexCol = 0.8, #labRow = FALSE, # Adjust font size
          labRow = row.names(top_genes))#paste0(1:nrow(top_genes),'-', rownames(top_genes))) # Do not show row labels

```

## Create Dummy Replicate Data

```{r}
tmp$enriched_total <- NULL


tmp$dummy_data <- rowMeans(tmp[,c(4:ncol(tmp))])
```

## Expand out df

````{r}

# Initialize an empty data frame to store the expanded data
expanded_df <- data.frame()

# Loop through each row in the original data frame
for (i in 1:nrow(tmp)) {
  # Get the median_CDR3 and abundance values for the current row
  cdr3 <- tmp[i, "median_CDR3"]
  abundance <- as.numeric(tmp[i, "abundanceS19"])
  
  # Repeat the median_CDR3 value according to the abundance and create a data frame
  expanded_row <- data.frame(
    median_CDR3 = rep(cdr3, times = abundance),
    abundance = rep(1, times = abundance) # We set abundance to 1 in each repetition
  )
  
  # Combine the expanded row with the existing expanded data frame
  expanded_df <- rbind(expanded_df, expanded_row)
}

# Reset row names
rownames(expanded_df) <- NULL

```



```{r}
boot_df <- data.frame()

i <- 1
while(nrow(boot_df) < 300000){
  set.seed(i)
  boot_df <- rbind(boot_df,
                   expanded_df[sample(1:nrow(expanded_df), 1000),])
  i <- i + 1
}


boot_df <- aggregate(abundance ~ median_CDR3, boot_df,FUN = sum)
```

```{r}
test <- merge(tmp, boot_df, by = "median_CDR3", all.x = T)
test[is.na(test)] <- 0

test$dummy_data <- NULL

colnames(test)[ncol(test)] <- "abundanceSynth"

tmp <- test
```

          dendrogram = "none",#"row", # Add row dendrogram
          key = TRUE, keysize = 0.85, key.title = "Z-score",
          density.info = "none", # Do not show density plot
          cexRow = 0.8, cexCol = 0.8, #labRow = FALSE, # Adjust font size
          labRow = row.names(top_genes))#paste0(1:nrow(top_genes),'-', rownames(top_genes))) # Do not show row labels

```
